commit.message:
Fix PUA glyph leakage in ingestion and eval report accounting

Ingestion: PDFs using Symbol/Wingdings for bullets encode them in the
Unicode Private Use Area (U+E000-U+F8FF). pypdf passed those codepoints
through verbatim, so glyphs like U+F0B7 were embedded into FAISS and fed
to the LLM as context. Add clean_text(): map known Symbol/Wingdings
bullets to ASCII, strip remaining PUA, NFKC-normalise (folds ligatures
so retrieval matches typed words), and collapse layout whitespace.
Rebuilding the index drops 295 PUA chars to 0.

Also drop the ascii/replace coercion in the sample-chunk preview, which
was hiding these glyphs behind "?" during the sanity check.

Evaluation: scores.append() ran only on the success path, while the
except branch recorded score 0 without touching scores. The average was
therefore computed over scored questions only (21/6 = 3.5) and printed
directly under "Questions evaluated: 10". Record errored questions as
null rather than 0, track attempted/scored/errored counts so the report
reconciles, and report both average_score (scored only) and
average_score_penalised (errors counted as 1). Flag scores recovered by
the regex fallback, which were previously indistinguishable from clean
judge output.

The committed report is re-derived from its own per-question data: 10
attempted, 6 scored, 4 errored on HTTP 402 (free-tier credits exhausted
at Q7). Note Q10, the refusal test, never ran.
